objective: One bounded genuine robot-driven nonfracturing touch, after a clear combined-scene entry check; never infer full23B qualification from contact visibility.

reuse.robot_controller: Corrected dry tracking controller; original mount and gains. Do not use old zero-gain coasting worker as if it were this controller.
reuse.target: Existing full4032-node supported equilibrium, original25-node remainder fixture and free cap, original material rest state and gravity/board model.
reuse.contact: Existing actual-CAD positive material quadrature, fixed-domain bounds, remap audits and exact wrench-origin transport.
reuse.no_repeats: Reuse coupon, static calibration, support, preload and dry-route evidence. No automatic rerun of passed suites.

entry_stage.name: Live combined-scene clear check
entry_stage.initial_state: Explicitly initialize supported target and robot at the verified20mm standoff. This is an assembly check, not replay of a continuously coupled approach from home.
entry_stage.motion: Hold this pose with corrected controller. Do not lower tool.
checks: Show the full target surface from actual Newton node coordinates; replace/hide the old stationary visual and avoid a duplicate collider.
Advance both engines to exactly matched endpoints;10target substeps per robot step, no unlogged stepping.
Actual current-CAD geometry establishes positive clearance; reject any target/tool overlap or nonzero contact exchange.
Support/board and original target admissibility gates hold; cap remains free; no damage or history changes.
Robot tracking, fixed mount, other-arm hold and original forbidden-contact/board/joint/speed limits pass.
No initial-state or robot pose rewrites after initialization; actual support dynamics and CAD geometry must be traceable.
entry_stage.success_claim: Live robot/target assembly and clock/display consistency only. This cannot close the moving contact/work gate.

entry_conditions: A new adapter combines corrected controller with live target pressure and once-only Native reaction. Existing dry and coasting workers cannot simply be concatenated.
Actual body pose versus q-derived CAD geometry, wrench origins and controller/applied effort channels verified for this configuration.

Complete work accounting and any required damping provenance are resolved, or a prospective fixture-specific replacement measurement contract is explicitly approved before results. Original failure verdicts remain.
Actual signed gap and motion/error bounds make the last approach and finite contact safe within the unchanged100micrometre penetration stop.
Freeze near-contact initial state, exact run counts/clocks, route and wall budget from the implementation before launch; reject unresolved manifest fields.
touch_stage.motion: From an explicitly clear measured pose, approach at no more than the existing2mm/s diagnostic speed. Stop commanded descent on first resolved positive contact, command withdrawal, then settle. Do not force reaching a preset depth or force.
touch_stage.signal_provenance: Existing static host candidate range, exploratory only; achieved load not guaranteed. Failure to reach it is inconclusive, never permission to deepen automatically.
touch_stage.stop_semantics: Stop/ramp down the command at a warning boundary that accounts for one coupling interval; hard-limit crossing terminates and records failure. The command stop is not a claim of instantaneous physical braking. Never clamp or overwrite the actual state to conceal a crossing.
touch_stage.exchange: PhysX owns robot motion and measured tool state. Newton owns target motion. Evaluate contact from actual state, apply opposite wrench once at the correct Native COM origin, record timing/lag/remap and accepted impulses. No duplicate J-transpose effort and no prescribed blade pose labelled as robot dynamics.
touch_stage.controls: One serialized protected invocation, with predeclared clear/loaded/replay/no-feedback controls if the executable contract can fit a justified budget. Reversed/off-centre and refinement requirements remain later23B gates, not implicitly passed by this screen.
exits: No target damage, topology change, bond deletion or slice pinning.
Positive contact comes from current geometry and material, not a scripted force waveform.
Independent raw readback verifies signs/origins, once-only transfer, actual robot response, matched clocks and replay/clear.
Apply the existing force/work gates below; an unmet gate stays failed/incomplete even if a contact animation looks plausible.
Complete withdrawal/clearance and loaded replay are distinct checks; this is not a post-cut reset.
touch_stage.target_signal_definition: Sum of absolute contact quadrature-sample force magnitudes, matching the static host candidate; distinct from the resultant-force hard stop.

existing_measurement_gates_retained.velocity_rounding_allowance: Only the already registered half-ULP allowance and cap; it did not close the old failed audit.
existing_measurement_gates_retained.no_silent_change: No averaging away the failed per-step requirement; impulse evidence is separate. Any alternative contract requires independent uncertainty justification and a held-out test specification before adoption.

performance.interpretation: These are total job costs, including setup/logging/controls, not steady-state timings. Dry GUI performance cannot predict live contact throughput.
performance.contact_runtime_freeze: Do not promise a seconds-long visible contact episode at the fine contact clock. Freeze a finite contact horizon and estimate cost from actual saved timing before approving a touch launch. If it cannot fit, return a concrete performance/design decision; do not silently coarsen or widen gates.

immediate_stopping_rule: Next implementation is only the0.1s live clear-stage adapter/check with a10minute wall cap and no repeated diagnostic branches. Return its verdict and one concrete touch-launch readiness decision before lowering the knife. No long contact run, shallow cut, full separation or training is authorized by this design document.
